name: Bicycle
summary: Ink sketch diamond-frame bicycle in side view facing right, with pedals, chain ring and handlebars.

params.name: y
params.note: floor line: the wheels stand on y

params.name: s
params.note: room scale: about 480 px wide and 380 px tall at s = 1

params.name: anim
params.note: drive = wheels and pedals turn (also on when vx is not 0)

params.name: vx
params.note: horizontal speed in px per frame (negative = left; set flip too)

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror so the bike faces left
